parameters.name: Points per Limb
parameters.tooltip: Fixed number of points for each limb segment

parameters.name: Points for Torso
parameters.tooltip: Fixed number of points for the Torso quad

parameters.name: Points for Head
parameters.tooltip: Fixed number of points for the Head

parameters.name: Corner Threshold (deg)
parameters.tooltip: Angles sharper than this become hard Bezier Cusps

parameters.name: Edge Snap Radius (px)
parameters.tooltip: How far points shift to lock onto true mask edge

parameters.name: Temporal Smoothing
parameters.tooltip: Applies a rolling average filter to bone points

parameters.name: Show When Behind Torso Less Than
parameters.tooltip: A hidden limb shows again once it is less than this far behind the torso (fraction of the torso's distance from camera, e.g. 0.04 = 4%).

parameters.name: Hide When Behind Torso More Than
parameters.tooltip: A limb fades out when it is more than this far behind the torso (fraction of the torso's distance from camera).

parameters.name: Drift Decay Rate
parameters.tooltip: How fast flow-tracked points decay back to rigid joint positions during dropouts
